title: Chickpea Meatballs & Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 small slices wholemeal bread, torn into pieces
4 whole roasted red peppers in brine (~320g), drained
small handful of basil leaves (~5g), plus extra to serve
steps: Pulse chickpeas in a food processor with bread, Italian seasoning, onion granules, garlic granules, parsley and seasoning until blended and starting to clump.
Shape into 20 small balls; place on a lined, sprayed baking tray; spray with cooking spray. Bake 20 minutes until golden and slightly crispy.
Make sauce: blend roasted red peppers, garlic, basil, oregano, almonds and seasoning until smooth.
Cook spaghetti according to package instructions. Heat sauce; stir in baked meatballs.
Stir spaghetti through sauce; serve with Parmesan, torn basil and more pepper.
notes: These meatballs also work with the Garlicky Meatball Pasta Bake (p.92).
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
